mapper.select: SELECT A.MHS_BRANDCD, A.MHS_CENTERCD, A.MHS_CLASSCD, A.MHS_CLASSROOMNM, A.MHS_CLASSNM, A.MHS_TEACHERNM, A.MHS_CLASSSTARTDAY, A.MHS_CLASSENDDAY, A.MHS_CLASSDAYOFWEEK, A.MHS_CLASSSTARTTIME, A.MHS_CLASSENDTIME, A.MHS_REGID, A.MHS_REGDATE, A.MHS_UPDATEID, A.MHS_UPDATEDATE, A.MHS_CLASSSTATUS, C.GROUP_NM AS MHSBRANDNM, B.CENTER_NM, D.MHS_MONITORNM FROM TB_MHSCLASSINFO A JOIN TB_CENTERINFO B ON A.MHS_CENTERCD = B.CENTER_ID JOIN LETTNAUTHORGROUPINFO C ON A.MHS_BRANDCD = C.GROUP_ID JOIN TB_MHSMONITORINFO D ON A.MHS_CLASSROOMNM = D.MHS_MONITORCD WHERE A.MHS_BRANDCD = #{mhsBrandcd} AND A.MHS_CENTERCD = #{mhsCentercd} AND A.MHS_CLASSENDDAY >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD')

SELECT MHS_BRANDCD, MHS_CENTERCD, MHS_CLASSCD, MHS_CLASSROOMNM, MHS_CLASSNM, MHS_TEACHERNM, MHS_CLASSSTARTDAY, MHS_CLASSENDDAY, MHS_CLASSDAYOFWEEK, MHS_CLASSSTARTTIME, MHS_CLASSENDTIME, MHS_REGID, MHS_REGDATE, MHS_UPDATEID, MHS_UPDATEDATE, MHS_CLASSSTATUS, MHS_CLASSINTRO FROM TB_MHSCLASSINFO WHERE MHS_CLASSCD = #{mhsClasscd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MHSCLASSINFO ( MHS_BRANDCD, MHS_CENTERCD, MHS_CLASSCD, MHS_CLASSROOMNM, MHS_CLASSNM, MHS_TEACHERNM, MHS_CLASSSTARTDAY, MHS_CLASSENDDAY, MHS_CLASSDAYOFWEEK, MHS_CLASSSTARTTIME, MHS_CLASSENDTIME, MHS_REGID, MHS_REGDATE, MHS_UPDATEID, MHS_UPDATEDATE, MHS_CLASSSTATUS, MHS_CLASSINTRO ) VALUES ( #{mhsBrandcd}, #{mhsCentercd}, #{mhsClasscd}, #{mhsClassroomnm}, #{mhsClassnm}, #{mhsTeachernm}, #{mhsClassstartday}, #{mhsClassendday}, #{mhsClassdayofweek}, #{mhsClassstarttime}, #{mhsClassendtime}, #{mhsRegid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{mhsRegid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{mhsClassstatus}, #{mhsClassintro} )
